blocks.html:
INFINITI FX50 CARBON FIBRE PARTIAL CAR WRAP – VINYL WRAP TORONTO

Vinyl Wraps are amazing; we can’t say it enough. A thin layer of a vinyl sheet can give your vehicle the look you always wanted without breaking the bank. Vinyl Wraps offer you a wide spectrum of colours and finishes to choose from. So, it’s safe to say there’s something for everyone. One of our customers wanted to get a vinyl wrap for their Infiniti FX50. The fact that he had an Infiniti FX50 shows he had a great taste in cars and on top of that he wanted to polish the look of his Infiniti FX50 to make it stand out among all others who have the same car.

Since vinyl comes in various finishes and colours, this customer had a very specific request. The customer wanted to wrap the hood, roof and back of his Infiniti FX50 with Black Carbon Fiber Vinyl. A great choice indeed. Carbon Fiber is one of the most popular finishes that Vinyl Wraps come in. As it’s clear from the name, it gives off the look and feel of actual carbon fibre minus the cost.

Getting real carbon fibre on a vehicle is not very ideal, due to the fact that it costs a lot. So, the simplest and most cost-effective alternative is to get a vinyl wrap with a carbon fibre finish. The look of Carbon Fibre wrap is indistinguishable from that of real carbon fibre. Not only does it look like real carbon fibre, but it also has a texture that makes the experience even more authentic and less gimmicky.

Here at Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we are always looking to do such interesting jobs. We believe we get to work with customers with very active imaginations and great taste. We have attached some images of the Infiniti FX50 on this page for you to see how much of a difference getting a vehicle wrap can make. The addition of Black Carbon Fibre Vinyl Wrap on the hood, roof and back certainly makes the Infiniti FX50 look a lot edgier and more premium.

At Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we use the best quality material available on the market, because we understand. When it comes to wrapping something as personal as a client’s vehicle, there are to be no compromises with the quality.

Update: The client came back and got the sides of the windows covered in the same Carbon Fibre, making the car look even cooler.

We only use vinyl wrap material offered by Avery Dennison & 3M because they offer a great variety of colour options, and various finish options along the premium quality that makes the vinyl wrap last for years. Now, just because there’s quality material doesn’t mean you can’t go wrong. It takes expert installers to actually take that premium quality material and install it on a vehicle with perfection so that it doesn’t have any improper cuts, bubbles, etc.

At Vinyl Wrap Toronto we have a team of experienced installers who have more than a decade of experience wrapping all kinds of vehicles and equipment. So, you can rest assured knowing your vehicle will be in capable hands and will come out looking just as you had envisioned. The owner of the Infiniti FX50 will testify to that.

Below is a list of some of the perks that vinyl wraps offer:

  • Easy to install and remove (Professionally).
  • Vinyl Wrap protects your vehicle from UV rays, Scratches & road Debris.
  • Vinyl Wraps offer a great level of customizability such as colours, and finishes and allow you to custom print whatever you want on them.
  • Vehicle wraps are easy to maintain, and the aftercare is minimal.
  • Vinyl Wraps last for 6-7 years.
  • For more benefits of getting a vehicle wrap, check our blog post here.

Quite often, the reason why people decide to get a vinyl wrap is that people are aware that they’re not the only ones who have that vehicle and they want to own something unique and special. Since there are a lot of people out there having the same factory standard vehicle as others, it sort of kills the pride of owning something one of a kind. Besides that, companies usually design cars using the general design language which is very minimal and would be accepted by most of the target customers.

However, everyone has a unique vision and taste and one standard look of a vehicle can’t satisfy everyone; at least not to the level where it becomes a pride to own it.

When you find yourself in that situation, where you wish to give your ride a personal touch of your own. You’d see the market has a lot of alternatives that allow you to customize your vehicle to your liking. The choice you make depends entirely on what you expect to accomplish and things like lifespan, colour options, finish options, maintenance, rollback, etc.

When all you want to do is, change the colour of your vehicle, or add a personal graphic or logo onto your vehicle, vinyl wrap is the way to go. Technically, you could also go for a custom paint job but you may want to read our blog post where we’ve explained why a vinyl wrap is better than getting a paint job, here. Check out more car wraps here.

If you wish to give your vehicle your personal touch and make it pop, call us at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W 1B4 to speak to one of our installers for a quote.
